title: オリジナル妖怪とおばけ
subject_en: ORIGINAL cute yokai/ghost creatures invented for this series (not any existing yokai character or franchise), each a separate chubby creature with a distinct silhouette, simple expressive faces, and one signature colour each. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: ぷるぷるのおばけ、からかさ、ちょうちん、こけだま。どこにもいない、オリジナルの妖怪12体。ハロウィンやイベントのキャラ、ゲームの素材に。
items: a mint-green jelly ghost with a wobbly bottom
a one-eyed folded umbrella creature hopping on one leg
a round red paper lantern creature with a long tongue-shaped tail
a long snake-like scarf creature wrapped in a spiral
a round fuzzy green moss ball creature with tiny feet
a small cloud creature with a sleepy face and a tiny umbrella tail
a round brown creature with a green leaf on its head, original design
a cat with two curly tails and a small bell
a pale yellow ghost holding a crescent moon like a swing
a teapot creature with a spout nose and steam hair
a raindrop-shaped blue creature with frog-like legs
a friendly dark-purple shadow creature with big yellow eyes
